guarantees.claim: timer_pulse is asserted when timer_enable is high and prescaler_cnt equals zero

assumptions.claim: timer_enable and prescaler_cnt must be stable and glitch-free while timer_pulse is used downstream
assumptions.cond: when timer_pulse is sampled or triggers logic
assumptions.risk: spurious timer_pulse pulses could cause false entropy sampling or hash progress increment

uncertain_points.claim: timer_pulse is a combinational output; if not synchronized or registered before use, glitches on timer_enable or prescaler_cnt could trigger multiple downstream events
uncertain_points.cond: when timer_enable or prescaler_cnt are not glitch-free
uncertain_points.risk: multiple false timer pulses could corrupt entropy accumulation or threshold detection

uncertain_points.claim: Signals threshold_hit, threshold_hit_q, threshold_hit_clr, hash_progress_d, hash_progress_q are declared but not assigned here; driving logic elsewhere must be verified for correct hit latching and hash progress counting
uncertain_points.risk: incorrect latching or clearing could cause missed or stuck entropy thresholds, affecting mask generation
